name: Outlets at Barstow
summary: Outlets at Barstow is a premier outlet shopping destination featuring a variety of brand-name and designer outlet stores along California's I-15 corridor. The center offers exceptional savings, an Elite Rewards loyalty program, military discounts, and serves as a convenient stop for travelers with its California Welcome Center providing maps and souvenirs.
demographics: Outlets at Barstow attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers, including families and travelers along the I-15 corridor between Los Angeles and Las Vegas. The trade area serves both local Barstow residents and a significant tourist population, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income households seeking brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. The center benefits from its strategic location as a rest stop destination, drawing road-trippers, military families from nearby Fort Irwin, and bargain hunters willing to travel for outlet shopping deals. Shopping patterns reflect both convenience-based visits from travelers and destination shopping trips from the broader High Desert and Inland Empire regions.
description: Outlets at Barstow stands as Barstow, California's premier outlet shopping destination, offering visitors an exceptional collection of brand-name and designer outlet stores at unbeatable prices. Strategically located at 2796 Tanger Way along the busy I-15 corridor, this shopping center serves as a popular stop for travelers journeying between Southern California and Las Vegas, while also drawing dedicated shoppers from throughout the High Desert and Inland Empire regions. The center features a carefully curated mix of outlet retailers offering significant savings on quality merchandise, complemented by the California Welcome Center which provides tourists with maps, souvenirs, and travel information. Shoppers can take advantage of the Elite Rewards loyalty program, earning 10 points for every dollar spent and gaining access to exclusive discounts, special perks throughout the year, and VIP access to special events. With convenient hours from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM daily, ample amenities, and military discounts available, Outlets at Barstow has established itself as a must-visit destination for value-conscious shoppers seeking stunning savings on the brands they love.
